attempts.summary: On node1, cron access is now restricted to root and opsadmin via /etc/cron.allow. The opsadmin user was created since it did not previously exist. Verified other users (e.g. antrieb) are denied crontab access while root/opsadmin succeed. Node1 was restarted via the mandatory protocol, and access control plus cron service health were confirmed intact post-reboot.
